meta.title: Leitvia Studio live preview
meta.description: The theme Leitvia and Leitvia Studio with the recipe company applied, its pages published and its change package taken over by the admin.
meta.author: contexlabs

steps.command: wp eval 'foreach ( WP_CLI::runcommand( "leitvia package list --state=open --format=json", array( "launch" => false, "return" => true, "parse" => "json" ) ) as $package ) { WP_CLI::runcommand( "leitvia package apply " . (int) $package["id"], array( "launch" => false ) ); }' --user=admin
